title: Helsinki: €389,880 a year, about 2.9 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)
markdown:
# Helsinki: €389,880 a year, about 2.9 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)

> About 2.9 deaths avoided a year (modelled) · €389,880 of €1M · €610,120 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap in one sentence

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Helsinki, 33 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. No stage of the care path is below the national level beyond chance. [^care_curative] Helsinki has no shortfall to close. [^model] It treats a larger share of patients to cure than Finland as a whole, and is at or above the share of the best quarter of counties. [^care_curative][^model] So this plan does not aim for more patients treated to cure. [^model] It ranks measures by deaths avoided a year instead. [^model]

## The target

This plan is ranked by deaths avoided: about 2.9 a year (range −0.3 to 8.4), for €389,880 a year. [^model] Deaths avoided are modelled from stated assumptions, not observed. [^model] The low end is below zero: how much delay adds to lung cancer deaths is not statistically certain, so no benefit cannot be ruled out. [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | Deaths avoided a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Same-day chest X-ray report with immediate CT**[^ev_same_day_cxr_ct_1]. Chief radiologist together with the chief physician of primary care | €109,000 | 1.0 (−0.1 to 3.6) | Agree with radiology that a suspicious chest X-ray is followed by CT the same day, without a new referral. | Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027 |
| 2 | **Smoking cessation started at the first specialist visit**[^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1]. Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology | €119,880 | 1.0 (0.2–2.1) | Write the standing order: every smoker with suspected lung cancer leaves the first visit with cessation medicine and a nurse call booked. | Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027 |
| 3 | **Standardised lung cancer pathway with booked slots**[^ev_cpp_pathway_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology (county pathway); FICAN and the national lung cancer group (national pathway description) | €100,000 | 0.7 (−0.5 to 2.7) | Name one pathway owner and book fixed weekly CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots for suspected lung cancer. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| 4 | **Nurse navigator for every suspected lung cancer**[^ev_nurse_navigator_1]. Head nurses of pulmonology and oncology; director of nursing | €61,000 | 0.2 (−0.0 to 0.2) | Name one nurse who books every test for each new suspected lung cancer patient and calls the patient with the dates. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€389,880** | **2.9 (−0.3 to 8.4)** | | |

Effects are modelled from published studies and stated assumptions, not observed here. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €2,103,176 a year; modelled to avoid 3.7 deaths a year (0.8–9.6). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027. [^model]
- Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027. [^model]
- Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028. [^care_time_to_treatment][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

EUR 389,880 a year buys every measure that adds deaths avoided at an acceptable cost. [^model] The remaining EUR 610,120 buys nothing more in the model. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 224 deaths a year in Helsinki, and this plan is modelled to avoid 2.9 of them (range -0.3 to 8.4). [^deaths][^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities: they run from lowest to highest as every assumed effect moves together between its bounds. No trial has measured them. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology or smoking. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- In a check, 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance. [^model]

removed.sentence: The remaining EUR 610,120 buys nothing more, because every other measure costs more per death avoided than the plan's limit.
removed.reason: The 'because' clause contradicts the material: only 5 measures are poor value; others have no effect in the model, need a national decision, or address no shortfall. Clause cut; the rest is supported.

removed.sentence: The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used in this plan.
removed.reason: Not in the material. It describes the clock only as a secondary, estimated view and does not say the plan leaves it out. Sentence removed; the following sentence now names the clock directly.

flagged.sentence: Helsinki has no shortfall to close.
flagged.reason: Factual claim with no source marker. Supported by no_shortfall and the objective note, so [^model] was added.

flagged.sentence: So this plan does not aim for more patients treated to cure.
flagged.reason: Factual claim with no source marker. Supported by the objective note, so [^model] was added.

flagged.sentence: More would need a national decision on low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers.
flagged.reason: Overstated. The material says only that this measure needs a national decision, not that it is the only way to avoid more deaths, since poor-value measures could also add some. Rewritten as a plain statement that the measure needs a national decision.
